question_cn: 国际象棋中「弱格」的准确定义是什么？
question_en: What is the precise definition of a weak square in chess?

options.text_cn: 当前没有己方棋子站在上面的格子
options.text_en: A square that no friendly piece currently occupies.

options.text_cn: 无法再被己方兵保护、且对方可以永久占据的格子
options.text_en: A square that can no longer be protected by a friendly pawn and can be permanently occupied by the opponent.

options.text_cn: 位于棋盘边缘、不重要的格子
options.text_en: An unimportant square on the edge of the board.

options.text_cn: 被对方兵直接攻击的格子
options.text_en: A square directly attacked by an enemy pawn.

explanation_cn: 弱格（Weak Square）指己方永远无法用兵来守护的格子。关键词是「永久性」——暂时没有棋子站着不叫弱格，但若周围的兵已经前进过去或者控制该格的象已消失，该格就成了对方可以永久驻扎的据点。弱格越靠近对方王或中心，价值越高。
explanation_en: A weak square is one that can no longer be protected by a friendly pawn. Permanence is key: a square is not weak just because it is temporarily unoccupied, but it can become a lasting outpost if the pawns have advanced past it or the bishop that controlled it has been exchanged. Weak squares near the king or center are especially valuable.
